guesses.question: You said Glass Harbour came into your life in the winter of 2021, and Second Lamp reached you during a night shift that same winter. Do these two songs belong together for you because both came at the bakery that winter?

quotes.quote: Glass Harbour came into my life in the winter of 2021, when I worked night shifts at a bakery in Leeds
during a night shift that same winter

what_it_did.quote: It made me slow down on that walk instead of rushing to bed.
That song kept me company until the ovens were done.
